outcome: Gestational Weight Gain (GWG) pattern (insufficient, adequate, excessive)
cohort: The study included 1745 pregnant women recruited from four health facilities in Ibadan, Nigeria.
finding: Excessive Gestational Weight Gain (GWG) was the most common pattern among study participants, associated with high maternal income and pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity, while insufficient GWG was linked to depression; additionally, women with obesity and excessive GWG had increased odds of postpartum haemorrhage.
